description: A React component for a modal dialog that allows users to select and add teams, with search, pagination, and confirmation features.

classes.name: TeamSelectorModal
classes.description: A React component class for a modal that enables team selection with search and pagination.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Loads initial list of teams when component mounts.

methods.name: componentDidUpdate
methods.description: Handles search term changes with debounce.

methods.name: handleHide
methods.description: Hides the modal and resets search term.

methods.name: handleExit
methods.description: Callback for modal exit, triggers optional dismissal callback.

methods.name: handleSubmit
methods.description: Handles form submission, triggers team selection callback.

methods.name: addValue
methods.description: Adds a team to the selected list, with optional confirmation for scheme change.

methods.name: setTeamsLoadingState
methods.description: Sets loading state for team list.

methods.name: handlePageChange
methods.description: Handles pagination, loads new page of teams.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Updates search term and resets page to 0.

methods.name: renderOption
methods.description: Renders a team option in the multiselect list.

methods.name: renderConfirmModal
methods.description: Renders confirmation modal for team override.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the entire modal with team selection interface.
